title: And if you saw it before, there are new jokes and they are hilarious!...
transcript: one of my favorite shows from Edinburgh Fringe last year to free a Mockingbird is playing a very limited two week long run currently at Soho Playhouse through May 25th and you should go to free a Mockingbird is a one person show written and performed by Grace Aki that tells us of three different generations of love and loss Grace Aki is such an incredibly gifted storyteller and these stories are so funny even at the same time that they're absolutely devastating so much of it is structured similar to a stand upset but with so much more depth to it ah and in addition to laughing I have cried every single time that I've seen this so you know not quite a stand upset but still incredibly funny now this run at Soho Playhouse is incredibly limited only playing through May 25th so try to see it if you can and tickets are very affordable full price with fees if you purchase online are $32 it's a little cheaper if you purchase at the door and there are discount options available on TDF and parts of the show actually take place in Soho so seeing it at the Soho Playhouse is a little bit like seeing parade in Atlanta just saying just saying
